text: おれの　ほうが　はやく　いっぱい　ポケモン　あつめたのに！

structure.en: I'm the one who (more than him)

structure.jp: ポケモン　あつめたのに！

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end means 'even though', and shows the speaker feels it is unfair. あつめたのに = 'even though I collected them!'

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.explanation: のほうが picks one side out of two as the one that is more so. おれの ほうが = 'I'm the one who (did it more)'.
